scope: Formal worker and installed library semantics; no running source/environment changes, GPU use, model loading, network requests or full test suite.

sampler.implementation: Installed BatchSamplerShard class executed unchanged in isolation on CPU

trainer_count_calculation.implementation: Installed Trainer.set_initial_training_values method executed unchanged in isolation

findings.assistant_only_and_template: Every train/eval row passes encode_sft_record: masked user prefix followed by the exact assistant suffix, empty think and im_end. The first row of each split also compares all input_ids and labels with make_sft_template. max_length=8392 and truncation_strategy=raise prevent truncation.
findings.two_epoch_coverage: The installed sampler produced all 20,000 indices once in each of two epochs. Batch 1 with accumulation 16 gives 1,250 updates per epoch and 2,500 total. Worker success additionally requires 40,000 consumed samples, epoch 2.0 and twice the sum of full sequence tokens.
findings.checkpoints_and_eval: DefaultFlowCallback schedules save and eval at 500, 1000, 1500, 2000 and 2500; Trainer runs _maybe_log_save_evaluate before honoring the stop flag. Save limit is five. The worker validates the exact five checkpoint steps and five eval-curve steps.
findings.heldout_loss_only: The verified 1,000-row heldout file is the sole eval_dataset. prediction_loss_only=True uses the non-generation prediction_step path. load_best_model_at_end=False; eval loss does not select the checkpoint.
findings.nan_and_oom: Every microbatch loss is checked; gradients are checked after clipping and before optimizer.step; logged train/eval losses are checked with logging_nan_inf_filter=False. Caught failures write training_stop.json and failed worker_result.json. No automatic retry or resume.
findings.gpu_and_root: GPU 1 UUID, initial memory below 2,048 MiB and one visible GPU are checked. Data, checkpoints and caches are external. The 30-second monitor records resource values but does not automatically abort on root or VRAM thresholds. Coordinator monitoring and final root-growth validation remain necessary.
findings.no_api: Formal check_model=False bypasses the installed ModelScope metadata version-request branch. Active process has all three HF offline flags and no proxies. The reviewed worker contains no remote inference API client. Earlier A1 metadata-request uncertainty is separately preserved in network_guard_audit.json.
findings.continuation: The detached watcher waits for PID 724147 and requires status=ok, 2,500 steps, 40,000 samples and no stop marker before launching heldout evaluation. The inference runner requires five checkpoints with rank 16/alpha 32, safetensors and matching trainer_state.global_step. Both use the same checkpoint directory.
findings.inference_compatibility: Saved template token proof and native context preflight are compatible: 34,489 + 256 < 40,960. Base plus five native LoRA strategies use 249 heldout tasks across six cells, greedy generation and 256 output tokens. No dev, F1 or remote API path.

notes.detail: Parent confirmed continuous coordinator monitoring and final root growth <=300 MB. No change requested to running code.

dataset_shuffle=False does not disable Swift train_dataloader_shuffle=True. A1/A4 use seeded shuffling without length grouping; A8 additionally groups lengths. Parent will correct the original sample order wording without altering measured values or archived source.
The run was encoding at review start. Actual completion, five checkpoint files and five finite eval-loss observations still require final artifact verification.

saved_training_args_check.explanation: Installed SwiftSft.run saves args only after _prepare_dataset returns; the running worker therefore completed all 20,000 train and 1,000 heldout row template/length validations before this artifact appeared.
